articles.title: Neurocrine Biosciences Announces Initiation of Phase 1 Clinical Study Evaluating NBIP-'2118, a Corticotropin-Releasing Factor Type 2 Receptor Agonist
articles.summary: Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: NBIX) today announced the initiation of a Phase 1 first-in-human clinical study evaluating the safety and tolerability of NBIP-'2118 in adult participants. NBIP-'2118 is an investigational corticotropin-releasing factor type 2 receptor (CRF2) peptide agonist and a potential first-in-class therapy for obesity.
